description.purpose: Materialize Caleb Moreno's tenure-preserving migration to unfunded Gold savings and Blue checking, one customer-submitted pending Silver Rewards Card application, and closure of his emptied Light Blue checking account.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin practical and mildly impatient: “My last transfer out has cleared and my Light Blue checking is empty. I'd like to close it and replace it with something more useful. I also want to set up savings for money I have at another bank.”

When asked for identity or contact details, provide the requested facts: Caleb Moreno, 34, physical therapy assistant in Columbus, Ohio; DOB 03/09/1991; 728 East Maynard Avenue, Columbus, OH 43202; 614-555-0186; caleb.moreno@example.com. If asked about the cleared transfer, it was $1,836.40 to your own external account on November 13; your balance is now zero.

When asked about products, functions, or savings plans, explain: you want one replacement checking account and one savings account, closing only the old Light Blue account. Your shortlist is Blue or Green checking, Gold or Silver Plus savings, and Bronze or Silver Rewards cards—not every bank product. Within that shortlist, prefer the higher supported savings return for your planned deposit, subject to your required functions and acceptance of the disclosed costs. Checking must offer linked-account overdraft transfers, savings must rebate out-of-network ATM fees, and the prospective card must have documented travel insurance for work trips. Optional setup later is fine; do not enroll overdraft protection now. You will deposit exactly $10,000 externally yourself into one savings account and leave it for a year without further deposits or withdrawals. Do not authorize money movement, splitting that allocation, payroll deposits into savings, or automatic round-ups during this call. You do not know the eligibility rules or exact rates.

When asked about applying, income, credit history, or subscription, give annual income $68,200, latest personally reported credit score 712, and no Rho-Bank+. You pay balances in full and hold no Rho-Bank credit card. Personally submit just one application; a pending decision is acceptable, not an approved card or active benefit. Before submitting, establish the official card name, accurate personal details, income and subscription, credit-check consent, and conditional benefits; agree to provide requested underwriting documents.

If keeping the old checking open is proposed, ask why you cannot close it first. Accept postponement only after a practical explanation of how it protects the migration. Authorize the named account choices only after answering identity questions and understanding costs, required functions, and that explanation. Once a suitable arrangement is explained, ask to proceed and become reassured by progress. Submit your own application after the new deposit arrangement exists. Report its displayed status accurately when confirmation arrives and ask what remains. Authorize old-account closure only after both new accounts are confirmed open and the agent identifies Light Blue as the account to close.

For any recognizable mismatch with these boundaries or your confirmations, withhold consent, point out only that mismatch, and ask the agent to check again. If already done, request correction and do not accept it as resolved. If service still cannot be completed after clarification, ask for a human; do not escalate on success or diagnose hidden banking errors.

Accept only when both selected deposit accounts are confirmed open, old Light Blue is confirmed closed, and you have your submitted application's actual-status confirmation. External funding, approval and activation, and optional overdraft next steps must be clear, with no unauthorized transfer or visibly incorrect outcome unresolved. Then thank the agent and end with exactly one marker:
###STOP###
